items.name: hook_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, punchy, urgent and surprised, like a scroll-stopping opener; leave a clear pause after the first question, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline; quieter and serious for the line about the invasion and fighting. Chars voices a funny deadpan cartoon character (a talking line on a map), short and dry.
lines: Did you know... North Korea and South Korea are still at war?
The shooting stopped in nineteen fifty-three... but the war never ended.
